description: Ruch rowerowy w Gdańsku is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Urząd Miejski w Gdańsku. Zbiór zawiera dane dotyczące ruchu rowerowego oraz inicjatyw rowerowych w Gdańsku. Coverage: Urząd Miejski w Gdańsku. The publisher named on the listing is Urząd Miejski w Gdańsku. Its keywords include zdrowie, sport. The listing shows 5 download or service links in XLSX, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
